newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks rise amid stability hopes.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks rise amid stability hopes.

text.p: Pakistani stocks rose on Monday amid hopes of political stability after the February 3 polls and dealers said the market might continue to rise on Tuesday.
"People are more confident that elections will finally go through and a stable government may take power," a dealer at KAB Securities said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 10.32 points, or 0.75 percent, to end at 1,381.02. Losers led gainers 81 to 77. Turnover rose to 24.99 million shares from 21.57 million on Sunday.
